work.summary: Connected AN15A scoring to a deliberately narrow production lifecycle: exact 24-hour, complete non-lower-bound forecast candidates and exactly matching later confirmed sales intervals. Added executable A-C CI and corrected AN15C incremental evaluation over AN15B.
implemented: Automatic idempotent 24h forecast snapshots from production listForecasts without changing returned forecasts.
Machine/product aggregation across forecast series to avoid column-level ledger collisions.
Exact interval matching requires previousClearAt == forecast asOf and report occurredAt == targetAt.
Sold-out outcomes remain censored and ineligible for exact-learning metrics.
Deterministic calendar context attach; no invented weather or holiday facts.
AN15C evaluates context improvement over AN15B calibrated/sparse-fallback prediction.
Executable Node CI covers idempotency, lower-bound/unknown exclusion, exact matching, censoring, sparse fallback, bounds, no-lookahead, unknown weather and incremental AN15B baseline.
PR #90 merged; pull-request and main-push AN15 hardening test workflows passed.
